content.title: FOX MLB Streaming App & Sites - Stream MLB Live Online | FOX One
content.text: From the first pitch to the final out, stream baseball LIVE on FOX One.WATCH 7 DAYS FREEDisclaimer: Offers are subject to change.See Fox One for complete terms and conditions.Where to stream MLB?Stream MLB games all season long on FOX One. Catch FOX Saturday Baseball, key matchups, and the biggest rivalries across the league — ALL LIVE.Looking for an MLB streaming app? FOX One makes it easy to watch MLB online with live games, replays, and highlights in one place. Whether you're exploring MLB streaming sites or need a reliable MLB live stream app, FOX One delivers across all your devices.For even more sports, bundle FOX One with ESPN — a single subscription with access to 50,000+ live events and 100,000+ hours of coverage across both platforms. Start your 7-day free trial and watch live on mobile, web, and TV devices with FOX One.Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat streaming service has MLB games?keyboard_arrow_downFOX One is a streaming service that has MLB games, letting you watch live matchups, replays, and highlights all season. You can also bundle FOX One with ESPN+ for additional live sports. Start with a 7-day free trial to begin streaming.What is FOX One?keyboard_arrow_downFOX One is a brand-new streaming service from FOX, launched on August 21. It's perfect if you've cut the cable cord or never had cable at all. FOX One brings all your favorite FOX channels together—like FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Weather, FS1, FS2, FOX Business, FOX Deportes, Big Ten Network (BTN), local FOX stations, and FOX Network — all in one place.With FOX One, you can stream live or watch shows on-demand. Subscriptions are $19.99/month or $199.99/year (save with annual).FOX Nation fans can also bundle with FOX One for $24.99/month or choose the annual bundle for even more savings.Additionally BTN can be added to any package for $12.99 per month or $89.99 annually.‍Plus, FOX One makes it easy to discover what to watch with personalized recommendations powered by AI.‍For updates and details, visit FOX.comWhat Devices are supported?keyboard_arrow_downMinimum supported devices and operating systems for FOX One:Apple TV (tvOS): tvOS 17.0Roku: Roku OS 11.0Android TV/Google TV: Android 6.0Fire TV: FireOS 6.0Samsung Smart TV (Tizen models 2019+): Chromium 64 & Edge 79Vizio Smart TV (2016+): Chromium 64 & Edge 79LG Smart TV (2020+): Chromium 64 & Edge 79Android mobile: Android 7 (Nougat) / Android Version 21+iOS mobile: iOS 16+Xbox: Series S, Series XCan I watch live TV in FOX One?keyboard_arrow_downYes! FOX One includes access to live content, and allows you to record live TV to watch later.What plans are available?keyboard_arrow_downFOX One offers annual and monthly subscriptions, plus add-ons. Some plans include a free trial at signup.Does FOX One offer a free trial?keyboard_arrow_downTo start your 7-day free trial:Go to fox.com and select “TRY 7 DAYS FREE”Choose a plan that includes a free trial (note: not all plans have a trial).Create your FOX One account with a username and password.Add your payment method—you won't be charged until the trial ends.Cancel any time during the trial from the Manage Subscription page.What happens to my FOX Nation subscriptionkeyboard_arrow_downIf you already have a FOX Nation subscription, you can keep watching just like you always have—either online at foxnation.com or in the FOX Nation App on all your favorite devices. Plus, you can now log in to your existing FOX Nation account right through FOX One. Want to subscribe to FOX Nation? You can do that directly from FOX One, whether you’d like it on its own or bundled with other great FOX One content.How Do I Sign In To FOX One with My TV Providerkeyboard_arrow_downUsing FOX One with your TV provider is easy! Here's how to get started, depending on the device you're using:On fox.com:‍Click TV Provider at the top of the page.Search and select your provider from the list.Sign in with your provider username and password.Once you're signed in, you'll be automatically redirected back to fox.com.On mobile apps:Tap Connect TV Provider in the appFind and select your TV provider.Enter your username and password on your provider's site.After signing in, you'll return automatically to the FOX One app.On Living Room apps (Smart TVs, Roku, etc.):Select Connect Provider in the app.Follow the simple instructions displayed on your screen.After signing in through your provider, you'll automatically be signed into your device.Now you're ready to start watching!‍
